title: Dream codes??
content: So excited to have found this sub. I also have been returning to the same “world” every night when I dream for years, but have been thinking about this particular instance for the past few months. I am not normally completely lucid in my dreams, but on occasion I am able to become lucid for a few minutes before I wake up and this one dream, I was talking to someone then and then I had asked to see a specific person and if I was able to go see them. And they looked at me with a straight face and said “but I don’t have their dream code” and I said “what is that?” And he just said “We need the dream code” and then I woke up. Just left me so confused and on edge lol. I know there’s not much detail to it, but tried to remember the best I could. The dream code was the most important part. Have any one had something similar said to them before?
